Features Ursula from The Little Mermaid, Scar from Lion King, Cruella De Vil from 101 Dalmatians, and more. Perfect entry-level electric scooter with step-on booster button, max speed of 7 mph, and rear foot brake.

title: Frozen 3-Wheel Light-Up Kick Scooter

title: Disney Princess 2-Wheel Light-Up Kick Scooter

Custom-designed to fit our Atlas, Axle, Bolt, Bolt Pro, Bolt Up, J5, J8, and LX10 e-bikes. (Not compatible with other Jetson models, including the Adventure, Journey, and Haze, which has its own rear basket .)

title: J8 Electric Bike

title: J5 Electric Bike
text: A small but mighty e-bike. Great for commuting, sized to store, and easy to transport. Go all-in with the motor using the throttle, or pedal to get “just right” electronic boosts of power.

title: Racer Electric Scooter
text: Solid all-around e-scooter for recreation and as transportation. Sail at your perfect pace – up to 15.5 mph – using 3 different speed settings and cruise control functionality. Foldable frame and all-you-need features set, including a USB port to power up your phone.

title: Helio X Kick Scooter
text: 2-wheel scootering; next-level styling. Kaleidoscopic illumination – in 20 available styles. Rides as good as it looks with smooth rolling wheels, a sturdy frame, and quick-react rear foot brake.

title: LX10 Folding Ride-On
text: Small and snazzy electric ride. Easy all-throttle maneuvering. Great for small-space living: Collapsible handlebar makes for easier storage.

title: Ora Pro Electric Scooter
text: One of our lightest-weight and quickest-charging scooters. Pick your pace, with 2 speed settings and cruise control functionality. Perfect for everyday riding.

title: Obsidian Kick Scooter

title: Litho X Hoverboard
text: Get-noticed styling; smooth hoverboard riding. 5 light settings give every ride just the right vibe. Lightweight frame gives the feeling of gliding.

title: Jupiter Kick Scooter With LED Lights
text: A smooth-rolling 2-wheel scooter with happy, galactic vibes. All-over LED lights twinkle like stars. Easy to take anywhere with a frame that’s lightweight and foldable.

title: Journey Electric Cruiser Bike (Version 2.0)
text: Every ride feels like the weekend. Just like our 7-gear Journey (Version 3.0), but with 3x the gears – 21, for super-nuanced command of the road. Easy, breezy all-day outings: 5 different levels of pedal assistance let you choose your effort output.
